messages:
Alex (Sales): FYI AcmeProc sent a vendor risk review; BCP/DR section flagged. They want short pasteable answers for RTO/RPO, backups, failover, SLA history. Can SRE + Legal help? :pray:

Priya (Solutions Eng): Quick: Acme checked a box for "RTO <= 1 hour". Do we have any offering that meets that? Also they asked whether backups are customer-controlled for Private vs hosted backups.

Sam (SRE): Short answers by tier:
- Hosted API: operated for high availability; no contractual RTO/RPO commitments. Typical operational recovery from infra incidents: hours (varies).
- Dedicated: SLA-backed. Standard 99.9% / Premium 99.95% monthly. Operational RTO target for full-environment failover ~2-4 hours depending on config.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): customer-managed; RTO/RPO depend on customer infra and agreed runbook. We provide snapshot tooling and recommended runbooks.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Can you confirm failover sequence wording (avoid absolutes)?

Sam (SRE): Failover sequence (concise):
1) Health detection & automated routing out of impacted region
2) KV/cache prefix fallback (best-effort)
3) Warm-standby Dedicated pools promoted if provisioned
4) DNS failover where configured (Private/Dedicated)
Note: timing depends on topology and provisioned capacity.

Lena (Legal): Suggested safe text for procurement form:
"Redwood Inference operates a tiered service model. Hosted API is run for high availability but does not include contractual RTO/RPO commitments. Dedicated capacity includes contractual uptime SLAs (99.9% standard, 99.95% premium) and operational recovery targets; specific RTO/RPO values and runbooks are defined per contract. Private deployments' recovery objectives are agreed case-by-case. Data protection, encryption in transit and at rest, and audit logging are provided; backup cadence and retention are specified in the Service Addendum. Statements are subject to the Master Services Agreement."

Alex (Sales): Good. They also asked "Do you perform DR tests?" Want evidence to attach.

Sam (SRE): We run quarterly DR tabletop exercises and annual live failover tests for Dedicated pools. Private customers coordinate tests with their ops team. We can provide a 1-page summary of the last tabletop and action items.

Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll assemble a short pasteable paragraph, attach a runbook excerpt and anonymized 12-month availability numbers for Dedicated on request, and send to Acme (cc legal).

deploy-bot: DR-test-scheduler scheduled: next-tabletop-2026-06-10 16:00 UTC (reminder 7d)

Alex (Sales): Action items:
- Priya: send questionnaire answers + runbook excerpt to Acme (cc Lena)
- Sam: prepare anon 12mo availability numbers and 1-page DR test summary
- Lena: sign off final wording

Priya (Solutions Eng): Sending now, will ping when delivered :raised_hands:
